privacy_rules: Private source systems remain read-only unless Dan explicitly requests a write action.
Raw emails, source exports, identifiers, secrets, booking references, claim numbers, and account details are never exported.
Health material is framed as tracking and clinician-conversation support, not diagnosis or treatment.
Old assistant or Akibwapedia-era claims are leads until checked against primary evidence.
Public copy cites source layers and coverage maps, not the private facts themselves.
